parent.successor_rule: Reproduce the accepted parent exactly, freeze every parent parameter, then train only successor-owned transition-trace residual parameters.
parent.checkpoint_file_hash_rule: The accepted torch.save file digest is verified only when reproducing the canonical basename native-vnext.pt; tensor authority remains independently bound by state_dict_sha256.

fresh_isolation.rule: No fresh:40..79 task may be instantiated by successor training or development code before a separately frozen candidate passes reproducibility and receives PRE_FRESH_LOCK authority.

architecture.parent_policy: accepted Neural vNext Native recurrent policy, frozen
architecture.trace_recurrent: GRUCell over ordered public transition tokens with exact padding masks
architecture.residual_policy: shared per-action residual scorer over parent action token + parent recurrent hidden + trace hidden
architecture.residual_initialization: zero final layer, making initialization exactly parent-equivalent
architecture.hidden_target_residual: second shared per-action residual head, hard-gated to public target_visible=0
architecture.hidden_target_residual_initialization: zero final layer; phase-1 replay remains behaviorally identical
architecture.phase2_trainable_scope: hidden-target residual only; parent and general residual frozen

transition_token.source: public before/after observations plus public step result only

training.teacher: same public-exploration-first then FIGG-18 train-only oracle target as accepted parent
selection_rule: candidate must solve strictly more development episodes than the frozen parent on dev:32..63
candidate may regress no family by more than 2 solved episodes versus parent
candidate must improve at least one of regime_switch or implicit_goal_regimes
among eligible candidates maximize development solved episodes
then maximize minimum family solved episodes

phase1_replay.rule: Phase-2 training is forbidden unless the general transition residual reproduces the phase-1 behavioral evidence exactly on dev:32..63.

phase2_selection_rule: evaluate parent, phase-1 replay, and hidden specialist candidates on dev:64..95 only
candidate must solve strictly more total dev episodes than phase-1 replay
candidate must solve strictly more implicit_goal_regimes episodes than phase-1 replay
visible-target family solved counts must equal phase-1 replay exactly because the hidden head is hard-gated off when target_visible=1
regime_switch may differ only if its public target is hidden for an episode; any aggregate regression below phase-1 replay makes the candidate ineligible
among eligible candidates maximize total dev solved

claim_boundary: R2 phase 2 remains development-only. Phase 1 used dev:32..63; hidden specialization uses a new dev:64..95 block. fresh:40..79 remains unopened and is forbidden until a candidate is frozen and bitwise reproduced.
